title: Sign-valued real encoding
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $f:\mathbb F_2^n\to\mathbb F_2$. Encode each value $f(x)$ as the real sign $(-1)^{f(x)}$; the resulting real-valued function has absolute value $1$ at every $x\in\mathbb F_2^n$.
